description: This file is a shell script that sets up a test environment to verify the behavior of a 'noop' fetch negotiator in a Git-related setup. It creates repositories, commits initial states, configures fetch negotiation algorithm, performs a fetch, and checks trace outputs to confirm expected behavior.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository in the specified directory.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits changes to the specified repository.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Configures repository settings, such as fetch negotiation algorithm.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
